_comment: English edition (Singapore) government resources. A hand-checked list: each URL was opened (HTTP 200) on 2026-11-14. Singapore Statutes Online (sso.agc.gov.sg) returned HTTP 403 to automated requests, so it is not listed and no fact depends on it.

meta.title: Official Singapore resources for hospital AI decisions
meta.description: Official sources behind this site: HSA’s medical device pages, the Ministry of Health’s AI guidelines, the PDPC and the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore.
meta.lead: This page collects the official sources behind the rest of this site, each one opened and checked.

notice: This list is not an endorsement and not complete. Pages and rules change; rely on the current text at each source.

programs.name: HSA — medical devices
programs.body: HSA’s medical device section, from which the guidance documents on software, AI and risk classification are reached.

programs.name: HSA — guidance documents
programs.body: The guidance-documents list, including GL-04, GL-07, GN-37 and the telehealth products guidelines.

programs.name: MOH — AI in Healthcare Guidelines 2.0
programs.body: The Ministry of Health’s page for AIHGle 2.0, with the guidelines, a roles and responsibilities infographic and a toolkit for deployers.

programs.name: PDPC — report a data breach
programs.body: The PDPC’s breach notification page and self-assessment tool.

programs.name: CSA — Cyber Security Agency of Singapore
programs.body: The agency AIHGle 2.0 names for reporting critical cybersecurity incidents.
programs.sourceLabel: CSA — Cyber Security Agency of Singapore
